title: Heavy metal for audio and video
summary:
A massive day for multimedia: new 4K image models, upgraded audio and video pipelines, five new community apps, and an AI cat that can now see your face to roast you better.

We migrated LTX video to v2.3 on GH200 hardware for faster rendering. Audio also got a massive bump: ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo now generates 30-second stereo music tracks in under 12 seconds, and we upgraded the OpenAI TTS endpoints to the latest mini and large models. Zero code changes required to get the better audio.

Added Wan 2.7 Image and Pro models to the API via DashScope. You can now generate 4K resolution images with models that actually pay attention to the details in your prompt.

CatGPT now uses Claude-fast's vision capabilities to analyze your avatar before insulting you. In less antagonistic news, we fixed a caching bug so API key updates in the dashboard reflect immediately without requiring a hard refresh.

highlights.title: The hive drops a beat
highlights.text: ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo is now live on the [Audio API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/audio/{text}). Generate 15-30 second stereo music tracks from text prompts in under 12 seconds.

highlights.title: Wan 2.7 enters the studio
highlights.text: Added `wan-image` and `wan-image-pro` to the [Image API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/image/models), bringing up to 4K resolution and thinking mode capabilities.

highlights.title: High fidelity buzzing
highlights.text: Upgraded the default OpenAI audio endpoint to the latest mini model and added `openai-audio-large` for premium text-to-speech.

highlights.title: LTX hits version 2.3
highlights.text: The LTX video model has been bumped to v2.3 and migrated to GH200 hardware for faster generation.

highlights.title: The cats can see you now
highlights.text: CatGPT now uses Claude-fast with vision to analyze your avatar and deliver highly personalized, image-aware roasts.

highlights.title: Laying down the tiles
highlights.text: Generate seamless repeating textures for games and backgrounds using Flux Schnell. [Try it](https://tiletile.netlify.app/)

highlights.title: Welcome to the Studio
highlights.text: A lightweight, open-source web UI for AI image generation powered by the Pollinations API. [Try it](https://image-ai.testes.eu.org)

highlights.title: Picture perfect previews
highlights.text: A dedicated tool to generate perfectly sized Open Graph preview cards for social media. [Try it](https://ogp-maker-teal.vercel.app/)

highlights.title: Shorts on autopilot
highlights.text: Automatically generate and publish YouTube Shorts directly from news URLs. [View repo](https://github.com/oguzgokyar/Video_Kur)

highlights.title: Fresh in the greenhouse
highlights.text: Easy AI-powered photo editing directly from the browser. [Try it](https://vision.scripted.my.id/)
